arise.abyss.rule.affixed.desc: Every room holds one affixed creature, whatever the rank.
arise.abyss.rule.relentless.desc: The Sovereign begins in its second phase. It sweeps the shadows from the first second.
arise.abyss.rule.thinned.desc: You descend with half the field slots.
arise.abyss.rule.unforgiving.desc: A fallen shadow does not return until you leave.
arise.advancement.abyss.desc: Close the first depth of the Abyss.
arise.advancement.abyss_ten.desc: Reach the tenth depth, where the Sovereign has no first phase.
arise.advancement.association.desc: Set foot inside a Hunter's Association.
arise.advancement.awakened.desc: You came within a step of the end, and something answered.
arise.advancement.first_shadow: It does not stay on the ground
arise.advancement.first_shadow.desc: Take the shadow of something you killed.
arise.advancement.gate_breaker.desc: Be there when a gate you ignored gives way.
arise.advancement.grand_marshal.desc: Raise a shadow to the grade that commands all the others.
arise.advancement.mastery.desc: Complete every quest in the chain.
arise.advancement.named_shadow.desc: Earn one of the seven shadows that are unique in what they do.
arise.advancement.red_gate.desc: Walk out of a Red Gate. The only way out was through the Sovereign.
arise.advancement.workshop: A soul that does not fight can work
arise.advancement.workshop.desc: Let a machine of the Soul Workshop finish a cycle.
arise.affix.frostbound.desc: Whoever strikes it in melee is slowed. Hit it from range, or with a Mage.
arise.affix.name: %1$s %2$s
arise.affix.shadow_eater.desc: Double damage against shadows. Change your squad, or fight it yourself.
arise.affix.swift.desc: Half again as fast. Do not run in a straight line.
arise.affix.thirsty.desc: Heals on every blow it lands. Do not get hit.
arise.affix.thorned.desc: Sends part of the damage back. Big slow hits, or let the shadows do it.
arise.affix.volatile.desc: Leaves a blast where it falls. Step away when it drops.
arise.archetype.beast.desc: Fast and fragile. Chases far and leaps on its prey.
arise.archetype.guard.desc: Steps between you and whoever is hunting you.
arise.archetype.mage.desc: Strikes from sixteen blocks and backs away from melee.
arise.archetype.tank.desc: Slow and tough. Taunts whatever was hunting you.
arise.blueprint.consumed: The Blueprint is used up in the build.
arise.blueprint.recipe: An ingredient in the %s recipe: the full grid is in your recipe book.
arise.catalyst.name: Catalyst %s
arise.gear.name: %2$s %1$s
arise.gear.slot.head: Head
arise.gear.unique.eye_of_darkness.lore: The System's first gift. Whoever wears it has no excuse left to fear the dark.
arise.gem.effect.hematite: %s of damage dealt returns as health
arise.gem.effect.jasper: %s of damage taken returns to the sender
arise.gem.name: Rank %2$s %1$s
arise.herald.army: What you kill should not stay on the ground. When the System allows it, %1$s beside a fresh corpse will take its shadow, %2$s will call it to your side, and %3$s will let you command the army. That is how you stop fighting alone.
arise.herald.farewell: Now go back. The place where you were about to die is still there, and so is the thing that was killing you — but you are no longer the one who left it. Arise.
arise.herald.greeting: You are not dead. You were stopped an instant before, and that is why you are here. I am the Herald: I speak for the System, and from today it watches you.
arise.herald.keys: %1$s to see what you are becoming. %2$s for your quests. %3$s for the world map, which marks the cities and every open gate.
arise.herald.quests: I will not ask for everything at once. One quest at a time, and each one opens something you did not have: stats, the army, the gates. Do what it says and the next door opens on its own.
arise.herald.system: The System measures. Every creature you bring down tells it something about you, and when it has seen enough it hands back a level. The panel in the top left is its voice: it will never lie to you.
arise.item.abyss_cube.blessed: Right-click: blessed — a gem, a catalyst, coins. For tonight.
arise.item.abyss_cube.cursed: Shift + right-click: cursed — two pieces one rank above. Not yet.
arise.item.regret_scroll.keeps: Your level, your souls and your army stay as they are.
arise.item.regret_scroll.tooltip: Returns every stat point you have spent.
arise.machine.abyss_well.hint: The souls are drawn on for soul coins, and now and then a catalyst.
arise.machine.shadow_forge.hint: The souls smelt in place of fuel. Never runs out.
arise.machine.soul_crucible.hint: Four souls and one catalyst become a single, stronger soul.
arise.machine.soul_lure.hint: The installed souls call others out of the Abyss.
arise.msg.ability.domain: Domain active: you and %s shadows are empowered.
arise.msg.ability.no_souls: You need %s soul coins, you have %s.
arise.msg.abyss.too_deep: The Abyss takes one step at a time. Depth %s is as far as it will let you.
arise.msg.city.arrived: You have arrived at the %s Hunter's Association.
arise.msg.city.auto_build: The Hunter's Associations don't exist yet: raising %s of them. Give it a moment.
arise.msg.city.building: Raising %s at %s, %s. This will take a while.
arise.msg.city.built: %s stands. The Hunter's Association is at %s, %s.
arise.msg.city.not_here: You are not inside a city.
arise.msg.city.queued: %s is queued: it goes up as soon as the previous one is done.
arise.msg.city.setup_done: All five Associations are already there.
arise.msg.compass.found: The needle settles: a rank %1$s gate, about %2$s blocks to %3$s.
arise.msg.compass.none: The needle spins loose. No gate calls to it from here.
arise.msg.cube.cursed: The rank %s cube opens the other way. What comes out is not for now.
arise.msg.cube.found: The gate leaves a rank %s Abyss Cube. How you open it is up to you.
arise.msg.daily.again: You fell. The count starts again.
arise.msg.daily.done: The day is closed. +%s stat point, and your strength back.
arise.msg.daily.failed: There is nowhere to take you. The System lets it pass.
arise.msg.daily.off: The System asks nothing of your days.
arise.msg.daily.opened: The System asks. Four things, before the day is out.
arise.msg.daily.penalty: The System takes you. Survive %s seconds.
arise.msg.daily.survived: You survived. The world is where you left it.
arise.msg.daily.warning: The day is nearly out, and %s of them are still open.
arise.msg.debug.lab: Laboratory raised: %s blocks. Everything is ready to try.
arise.msg.debug.lab_map: Gates on the north wall, machines on the south wall, the chest at the centre.
arise.msg.gate.already_open: You already have a gate open. Leave with /arise leave.
arise.msg.gate.boss_room: You feel the presence of the rank %s guardian.
arise.msg.gate.breached: The rank %s gate has broken. What was inside is out.
arise.msg.gate.breaching: The rank %s gate is giving way. Close it, or it will open itself.
arise.msg.gate.entered: Rank %s gate opened — %s rooms. The way out is at the end.
arise.msg.gate.exit_open: The guardian has fallen. The way home has opened in its hall: touch the stone to return.
arise.msg.gate.hunt_late: Too slow. The reward is the ordinary one.
arise.msg.gate.hunt_over: The hunt is over. The gate still opens on the Sovereign — it just pays like any other.
arise.msg.gate.no_dimension: The gate dimension is not available in this world.
arise.msg.gate.not_inside: You are not inside a gate.
arise.msg.gate.recovered: The gate you were in no longer exists: you have been sent back.
arise.msg.gate.red_no_seal: The Seal is dead in here. Nothing answers it.
arise.msg.gate.red_sealed: The gate has sealed. The only way out is through the Sovereign — and the cold does not wait.
arise.msg.gate.spawn_failed: No suitable spot nearby: try moving.
arise.msg.gate.spawned: A rank %1$s gate opened about %2$s blocks to %3$s.
arise.msg.gate.varco_failed: The gate could not take shape here.
arise.msg.gate.varco_gone: That gate is no longer there.
arise.msg.gate.varco_opened: A rank %s gate has opened. Right-click it to analyse it.
arise.msg.gear.demoted: Your rank no longer holds %s pieces: they are in your dimensional space.
arise.msg.gear.granted: Obtained: %s. It is in your dimensional space.
arise.msg.gem.auto_extract: The obsidian answers on its own. %s
arise.msg.gem.needs_bench: Only the Hunter's Association bench can take a gem out intact.
arise.msg.gem.unknown: That gem isn't yours, or it's gone.
arise.msg.locked: The System hasn't granted you %s yet.
arise.msg.map.in_gate: The map is read outside a Gate.
arise.msg.market.no_fee: The broker wants %s soul coins. You have %s.
arise.msg.market.no_souls: Not enough soul coins. One coin costs %s.
arise.msg.market.redeemed: %s coins taken back, for %s soul coins.
arise.msg.quest.awakening: You came within a step of the end, and something answered. The System is yours.
arise.msg.quest.chain_done: No quests left. The System is silent.
arise.msg.quest.reset: You are an ordinary person again.
arise.msg.respec.done: %s points came back. Spend them better.
arise.msg.respec.nothing: You have spent nothing. There is nothing to regret.
arise.msg.shadow.cannot_name: %s is not worthy of a name yet: it takes the grade of %s, and it is only %s.
arise.msg.shadow.extracted: Arise. %s — %s of rank %s joins the army (%s/%s).
arise.msg.shadow.fallen: %s has fallen. It returns in %s seconds.
arise.msg.shadow.max_level: This shadow is already at max level.
arise.msg.shadow.named_keeps_name: %s keeps the name it was given. It is not yours to change.
arise.msg.shadow.no_target: No corpse to extract a shadow from.
arise.msg.shadow.not_enough_souls: You need %s soul coins, you have %s.
arise.msg.shadow.nothing_summoned: There is no one out there to command.
arise.msg.shadow.overflow: Your army is full (%s): the soul stays loose, ready for the Workshop.
arise.msg.shadow.recalled_travel: The army does not cross worlds: %s shadows returned.
arise.msg.shadow.summon_limit: You can keep at most %s shadows summoned.
arise.msg.shadow.survey: A rank %1$s %2$s lies there. Extraction chance: %3$s%%.
arise.msg.shadow.unknown: That shadow is not part of your army.
arise.msg.shop.header: Abyss Shop: %1$s entries, reroll at %2$s soul coins, turns over in ~%3$s minutes.
arise.msg.shop.no_souls: You need %1$s soul coins, you have %2$s.
arise.msg.spend.invalid_amount: You must spend at least one point.
arise.msg.threshold.last_stand: The System does not let you fall. Not yet.
arise.msg.workshop.disabled: The Workshop is switched off in the configuration.
arise.named.bellion.desc: His command aura reaches the whole army, not only those in the field.
arise.named.beru.desc: Heals the Monarch when he falls below half his health.
arise.named.greed.desc: While it stands in the field, every kill pays double in soul coins.
arise.named.igris.desc: The red knight. Steps in first, and speaks once he has earned the right.
arise.named.iron.desc: Taunts at twice the range of any other Colossus.
arise.named.tank.desc: Nothing moves it. Knockback simply does not apply.
arise.named.tusk.desc: Casts the shadow lance from twenty-four blocks instead of sixteen.
arise.npc.banker.greeting: Click to mint coins. Hold shift to bring them back.
arise.npc.clerk.greeting: Click to travel. Hold shift for the Abyss Shop.
arise.npc.draftsman.greeting: No blueprint, no machine. I keep all four.
arise.npc.gate_broker.greeting: I open one at your rank. Waiting is free; this is not.
arise.npc.herald.greeting: I speak for the System. Click to listen.
arise.npc.herbalist.greeting: Nobody clears a gate on an empty stomach.
arise.npc.jeweller.greeting: Sockets and settings, without going into the Association.
arise.npc.quarrier.greeting: Deepslate and obsidian. Walls for your machines.
arise.npc.smelter.greeting: Ingots, coal, blaze rods. The Forge eats well here.
arise.npc.soul_trader.greeting: Soul sand, echo shards, and catalysts for the low grades.
arise.objective.essence.desc: Clear the rooms. The guardian becomes optional — and so does the fight you cannot win.
arise.objective.hunt.desc: The Sovereign, and quickly. Every room you clear is time you do not have.
arise.objective.sovereign.desc: Fell the guardian. The way home opens in its hall.
arise.quest.awakening.brief: There is nothing to prepare. Keep living, and let the world try.
arise.quest.awakening.goal: The System arrives when it's needed. Nothing to do: stay alive.
arise.quest.awakening.lore: The System does not choose the strong: it chooses those who reach the edge and do not cross it.
arise.quest.equipped.brief: Open the Hunter's menu with %s. Hold shift and click a piece: it goes straight to its slot.
arise.quest.equipped.lore: The System will not dress you. It hands you the pieces; where they go is your business.
arise.quest.first_gate.brief: Click the gate to survey it before entering; %s marks it on your map. Inside, when the guardian falls, the return stone appears in its hall.
arise.quest.first_gate.goal: Clear %s gate by felling its guardian.
arise.quest.first_gate.lore: Gates open by themselves, where the world is thinnest. Closing one means going in and felling what holds it open.
arise.quest.first_shadow.brief: Press %s beside a fresh corpse: you have a few seconds before the shadow is gone.
arise.quest.first_shadow.lore: A body that has just fallen holds its shadow a little longer. Then it disperses, and that soldier will not come back.
arise.quest.first_steps.brief: Experience comes from killing. The panel in the top left says how far the next level is.
arise.quest.first_steps.lore: Before it grants you anything, the System measures how much you can carry. Levels are its unit.
arise.quest.the_army.brief: Any hostile creature counts, killed by you or by your shadows. The tally appears above the hotbar.
arise.quest.the_army.lore: Every creature that falls leaves something nobody else can see. The System wants to be sure you have seen enough of them.
arise.quest.the_association.brief: The Seal you have just received opens the list of cities from anywhere in the world: hold it and right-click. %s shows you where they are.
arise.quest.the_association.goal: Set foot inside a Hunter's Association.
arise.quest.the_association.lore: Where Hunters are many, they have built. Five cities, and in each one a door with the same crest.
arise.quest.the_broker.brief: At the Gate Broker, on the square: you pay, and a gate of your rank opens where you stand.
arise.quest.the_broker.lore: Waiting for a gate to open costs nothing. The Broker sells the one thing the Abyss never gives away: the moment.
arise.quest.the_forge.brief: The Shadow Forge smelts like a furnace, but the fuel is the souls installed in it. Load the ore and let it work.
arise.quest.the_forge.lore: Fire costs. Working souls do not: they burn what is left of them, and you need nothing else.
arise.quest.the_fusion.brief: In the Crucible: four souls of the same rank plus a catalyst. One comes out, a rank higher.
arise.quest.the_fusion.goal: Fuse four souls into one, %s time
arise.quest.the_fusion.lore: Four weak souls do not make a strong one on their own: something has to hold them together while they melt.
arise.quest.the_lure.brief: Craft the Soul Lure at a workbench — the recipe has just appeared in your book — place it, and put a Loose Soul inside. The Blueprint is used up.
arise.quest.the_lure.lore: A soul that does not fight can work. That is the difference between a Monarch and a gravedigger.
arise.quest.the_market.brief: There are nine shops on the square. Right-click whoever stands behind a counter: sellers open the trading window, services just do their thing.
arise.quest.the_market.goal: Speak to someone behind a counter
arise.quest.the_market.lore: Behind every counter is someone who stopped walking into gates and started selling to those who do.
arise.quest.the_mint.brief: At the Bank of the Abyss: click to mint, shift-click to bring coins back. The Bank keeps a cut on the way back.
arise.quest.the_mint.goal: Mint %s Soul Coins at the Bank
arise.quest.the_mint.lore: A soul coin inside the System is a number. A Soul Coin is an object: you hold it, you spend it, you lose it.
arise.quest.the_power.brief: Abilities cast from %1$s to %2$s and sit above the hotbar. The dim ones are waiting for the level written on them.
arise.quest.the_power.lore: A power merely owned is not a power: it is a weight nobody asked you to carry.
arise.quest.the_recruit.brief: Open the army and enlist a Loose Soul: it becomes a shadow again, at the rank it holds now.
arise.quest.the_recruit.lore: A soul that has worked long enough can fight again. Few things are more loyal than a soldier who has been a labourer.
arise.quest.the_surplus.brief: Extract with a full army, or dismiss a shadow: either way you end up holding a Loose Soul.
arise.quest.the_surplus.lore: The army has a limit. What you extract beyond it is not lost: it stays a loose soul, with no body and no duties.
arise.quest.the_trade.brief: Open the Abyss Shop with %s. The stock rotates: what you don't buy is gone next rotation.
arise.quest.the_trade.goal: Buy %s entry at the Abyss Shop.
arise.quest.the_trade.lore: The Abyss gives nothing away, but it trades gladly. The soul coin you have gathered is worth something outside you too.
arise.quest.the_well.brief: The Abyss Well turns the souls' labour into soul coin, by itself, as long as it holds souls.
arise.quest.the_well.goal: Draw %s soul coins from the Abyss Well
arise.quest.the_well.lore: The Abyss pays those who send it souls to work. Not generosity: a wage withheld at the source.
arise.screen.army.empty: No shadows yet. Kill an enemy and press the Arise key.
arise.screen.army.hint: Click to pick · %1$s summons the squad, %2$s recalls · %3$s orders the kill, %4$s holds
arise.screen.army.pick: Pick a shadow from the list.
arise.screen.army.sort.name: name
arise.screen.army.title: Shadow Army
arise.screen.detail.grade_commands: It commands: +%s%% damage to the others in the field.
arise.screen.detail.grade_named: Its grade allows it a name of its own.
arise.screen.detail.grade_plain: From the grade of Knight it may bear a name.
arise.screen.detail.name: Name
arise.screen.detail.title: Shadow details
arise.screen.gate.hint: The gate closes on its own: going in or walking away is a timed choice
arise.screen.gate.title: Gate analysis
arise.screen.gem.bench_far: Far from the bench: here you can only socket or shatter
arise.screen.gem.cost: %1$s soul coins — extraction %2$s at the bench
arise.screen.gem.title: Socketing
arise.screen.hub.hint: Travel between built Associations is free
arise.screen.hub.subtitle: Travel network
arise.screen.hub.title: Hunter's Association
arise.screen.hunter.hint: Click to pick · wheel to scroll · Esc to close
arise.screen.hunter.pick: Pick a piece from the list.
arise.screen.hunter.title: Gear
arise.screen.map.asleep: Dormant in an unloaded chunk (%s left when last seen)
arise.screen.map.hint: Drag to move · scroll to zoom · hover a mark
arise.screen.map.title: World map
arise.screen.quest.abyss: Abyss — depth %1$s, best %2$s s. Depth %3$s is open.
arise.screen.quest.abyss_first: The System is silent. The Abyss is not: shift-click the Association stone.
arise.screen.quest.hint: Every quest opens a system · %s to close
arise.screen.quest.title: Quests
arise.screen.shop.empty: Sold out. Come back next rotation.
arise.screen.shop.hint: The stock turns over on its own every in-game day
arise.screen.shop.pick: Pick an entry from the stock.
arise.screen.shop.sealed_hint: Slot and modifiers show after the purchase.
arise.screen.shop.title: Abyss Shop
arise.screen.status.title: Status
arise.shadow.name: Shadow of %s
arise.soul.name: Soul of %s
arise.soul.tooltip.hint: Shift + right click to enlist it
arise.soul.trait.avidita.desc: more soul coins from the Well
arise.stat.absorption.desc: Extra yellow hearts: they take the hit first and never regenerate.
arise.stat.agility.desc: You move faster. Past a point the client cannot keep up with the physics: that is what the cap is for.
arise.stat.endurance.desc: Armour: it cuts the damage that lands. Good against almost everything, not against hunger or the void.
arise.stat.fortune.desc: Better loot from everything the game rolls at random.
arise.stat.haste.desc: You strike more often. A swing before the bar refills lands for a fraction: this shortens the wait.
arise.stat.reach.desc: You reach entities further away without stepping closer.
arise.stat.resolve.desc: You get pushed less when hit. At one, you stop being pushed at all.
arise.stat.strength.desc: Every swing takes more life. It adds to the weapon's damage, it does not replace it.
arise.stat.toughness.desc: Cuts how far big hits punch through armour. It only counts if you have armour.
arise.stat.vitality.desc: More hearts on the bar. The most direct way not to die.
arise.subtitle.boss_phase_1: Your shadows will not hold it.
arise.subtitle.penalty: You did not do what was asked.
arise.threshold.agility_sprint.desc: Falling while sprinting does no damage, from any height.
arise.threshold.agility_step_haste.desc: Shadow Step recharges in half the time.
arise.threshold.agility_step_reach.desc: Shadow Step carries you half again as far.
arise.threshold.endurance_poison.desc: Poison and wither do not touch you.
arise.threshold.strength_command.desc: One more shadow in the field.
arise.threshold.strength_host.desc: Another shadow in the field: two more in all.
arise.threshold.vitality_fall.desc: Falls of less than nine blocks do no damage at all.
arise.threshold.vitality_last_stand.desc: A killing blow leaves you at half a heart. Once every ten minutes.
arise.tutorial.built: Hall of Awakening standing at %1$s %2$s %3$s, in the gate dimension.
arise.tutorial.herald.gift: The System advances you %s soul coin.
arise.tutorial.herald.more: Right-click the Herald again to go on.
arise.tutorial.leave.subtitle: The world is where you left it.
arise.tutorial.leave.title: Arise.
arise.tutorial.restarted: You are back in the Hall of Awakening.
arise.tutorial.sanctum.arrived: Someone is waiting at the far end of the hall. Walk over and right-click them.
arise.tutorial.sanctum.resumed: You are still in the Hall of Awakening. The Herald is waiting.
arise.tutorial.sanctum.subtitle: You are not dead.
arise.tutorial.sanctum.title: The Hall of Awakening
arise.tutorial.welcome.1: There is nothing to do yet: no keys, no powers, no panel.
arise.tutorial.welcome.2: The System chooses those who come within a step of the end. Try not to get there too soon.
arise.tutorial.welcome.subtitle: Something is watching you.
arise.tutorial.welcome.title: Arise
arise.unlock.abilities.hint: The four abilities sit above the hotbar and cast from %1$s to %2$s: they open as you level.
arise.unlock.army.hint: %1$s beside a fresh corpse extracts its shadow; %2$s opens the army.
arise.unlock.cities.hint: The Desk in any Association will take you to the other four cities.
arise.unlock.coin.hint: At the Bank of the Abyss: click to mint soul coin into coins, shift-click to bring them back.
arise.unlock.crucible.hint: The Crucible fuses four souls into one of a higher rank.
arise.unlock.enlist.hint: A loose soul can fight again: enlist it into your army.
arise.unlock.forge.hint: The Shadow Forge smelts without fuel: the working souls are the fire.
arise.unlock.gates.hint: Gates open near you on their own: click one to survey it before entering, and %s marks it on your map.
arise.unlock.gear.hint: %s opens the Hunter's menu: slots unlock with your rank.
arise.unlock.gems.hint: Gems are set at the Association bench, or at the market's Jeweller.
arise.unlock.lure.hint: The Soul Lure gathers loose souls by itself, as long as it has something to work with.
arise.unlock.mastery.hint: Nothing is missing now: from here the System falls silent and watches.
arise.unlock.services.hint: The Broker opens a gate to order, at your rank, for a fee.
arise.unlock.shop.hint: %s opens the Abyss Shop: the stock rotates, and what you don't buy is gone.
arise.unlock.stats.hint: %s opens the status screen: points are spent there, one at a time.
arise.unlock.system.hint: The panel in the top left is the System: level, soul coin and experience.
arise.unlock.well.hint: The Abyss Well turns the souls' labour into soul coin.
arise.unlock.workshop.hint: Surplus souls become workers: machines are built from Blueprints.
